notes: [0004] and [0005] name Tembotrione as material known from WO 00/21924, Example No. 3 in Table 1 there, and state that material made to that disclosure clumps and precipitates in suspension formulations. Prior-art material, so role is other. [0005] speaks of eine Modifikation von Tembotrione with no numeral and no properties, which is a generic reference and not a named crystal form, so no modification record is emitted from this section. The patent numbers WO 00/21924 and EP 1 314 724 A1 and the Bernstein / Davey / Henck citation are citations, not compounds. Polymorphe and organische Verbindungen are class terms.

[0003] names Sulcotrione as the herbicidal active ingredient whose two crystal structures are known from EP 1 314 724 A1. This is read carefully: the German prints Sulcotrione, a different herbicide from tembotrione, and it is the only compound in this section that is not tembotrione. It is prior art here and no step of this patent prepares it, so commercially_available is true. The English ISO common name sulcotrione and the German Sulcotrione differ only in capitalisation; the printed capitalised form is kept as the alias. Functional group tags follow the ISO common name, a 2-(2-chloro-4-methanesulfonylbenzoyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione.
